verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own ERISA & Executive Compensation page says it advises on equity-based structures, including stock options, phantom equity and appreciation rights, and mentions UK incentives. Its employment page adds compensation plans. That covers option-plan design, but the local schemes named in the story are only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit UK EMI coverage, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOPs, any description of plan-design deliverables, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: We advise companies on equity-based structures such as stock options, stock purchases, profits interests, 'phantom' equity, and appreciation rights arrangements
We develop and negotiate employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, compensation plans and employment separation agreements.
